svg.text: | Big Data Network Intrusion Detection, Streaming Analytics & Graph Topology
A. OFFLINE INGESTION, ML TRAINING & GRAPHX TOPOLOGY PIPELINE

g.text: 8 CSV Network-Flow Captures (~1 GB) • 225,745 flows analyzed
• DataIngestion.scala: PERMISSIVE CSV parsing, distributed executor read
• DataCleaning.scala: Rules C1–C6 (Resolves duplicate header: fwd_header_length_2)
• Double casting of 78 features; non-finite tracking via has_invalid_numeric
Cleaned Parquet Dataset (Single Source of Truth)
Spark MLlib PipelineModel Validation Results (Test Set: 44,862 flows)
• Attack F1-Score: 98.59% (0.98595) • ROC-AUC: 0.9991 • False Negative Rate: 0.09% (23 missed)
Actual BENIGN: True Negative (TN) = 18,631 | False Positive (FP) = 704 (3.64%)
Actual ATTACK: False Negative (FN) = 23 (0.09%) | True Positive (TP) = 25,504 (99.91%)
Random splitting exhibits session burst leakage in network telemetry. Operational generalization
requires cross-day evaluation to prevent overestimation from shared connection signatures.
• Event Simulation: Replays flows from test fixtures / cleaned dataset
• Generates unique flow_id, timestamps, and JSON flow payloads
• SEC-05 Payload Guard: Rejects oversized messages exceeding 64 KB
• Isolated Docker Compose Service (sparkshield-kafka) • No ZooKeeper
• Topic: network-flows (3 partitions) • Bound strictly to 127.0.0.1:9092 (SEC-01)
• Payload size validation (≤64 KB) & JSON schema deserialization
• Struct-based UDF validates finite bounds on 78 numeric features (SEC-04)
• Malformed, oversized, or non-finite records routed to quarantine (SEC-06)
• foreachBatch executes PipelineModel.transform() across executor partitions
• VectorAssembler + StandardScaler applied consistently with training
• Idempotent partition persistence organized by micro-batch ID
Lightweight HTTP Server (dashboard/server.py on 127.0.0.1:8088) & Single Page Application (dashboard/index.html)
